jobs.title: Gametech Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

The Gametech Innovation team
is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.

As a Mid-Level Developer
within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What It Means On a Daily Basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What Success Will Look Like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who You Would Be Working With

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test You will be given a case study to complete.
Second interview A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine or Unity; and in C++ and C#
Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development work
Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self-explanatory code
Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

Who You Are

Naturally curious you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
Solution-driven you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
Private medical health insurance.
Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
Free language courses.
Work-from-home hybrid model.
Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

Life at
Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (68315E1)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a regulated payments business to hire a Senior Software Engineer focused on modernising established systems. The challenge is to make complex C# and SQL logic easier to understand and maintain while keeping revenue-critical services running safely.

You will work across legacy and modern .NET, extracting business rules into tested components and improving the services around them. This is a role for someone who enjoys understanding why an existing system behaves as it does before changing it, rather than starting with a wholesale rewrite.

The Role

Trace business rules through C#, JavaScript and SQL stored procedures, then separate them into components that can be tested independently.
Build services with clear dependency management, access controls and logging so their behaviour can be understood in production.
Investigate problems across APIs, data processing and messaging, including failures caused by the way systems interact.
Compare new calculations with existing outcomes in shadow mode before allowing changes to affect live processing.
Refactor SQL Server logic carefully, preserving the correctness of client-money handling.

What We're Looking For

Senior hands-on experience with .NET 6+ and .NET Framework 4.8, including MVC5, WebAPI 2 and Entity Framework 6.
Deep SQL Server experience and confidence reading and safely changing complex stored procedures.
Working JavaScript or TypeScript knowledge and the ability to follow behaviour across application and database code.
A measured approach to modernisation, using tests and comparison of outputs to demonstrate that changes are safe.

Useful Additional Experience

Experience with AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS or RDS would help. This could suit a senior .NET engineer who finds satisfaction in untangling established systems and improving them incrementally, with correctness taking priority over a particular architectural fashion.

jobs.description:

Role Overview

We’re representing a highly successful quantitative research and technology firm operating one of the most sophisticated proprietary engineering environments in the financial markets. The organisation builds a significant proportion of its technology internally, supporting complex research and production workloads where reliability, performance and protection of valuable intellectual property are critical. This team sits at the intersection of software, infrastructure and security, developing bespoke platforms rather than relying heavily on external products.
This is fundamentally a systems-focused software engineering role rather than a traditional cyber-security position. You’ll join a small, highly technical team responsible for building and operating proprietary services across backend development, Linux infrastructure, automation, APIs and underlying server hardware. Engineers are expected to investigate problems deeply, own systems throughout their lifecycle and improve or rebuild components where a better engineering approach exists, while gaining exposure to areas including IAM, MFA, cryptography and secure infrastructure...

Key Responsibilities

Design, build and operate proprietary backend services and internal platforms supporting highly sensitive research, intellectual-property and production workflows
Develop production-grade services and REST APIs across languages including C#/.NET, Python, Go and Rust, with opportunities to contribute increasingly to Rust-based systems
Automate Linux server provisioning, configuration and administration using Ansible and CI/CD tooling, including bootstrapping environments from bare-metal infrastructure
Engineer concurrent, highly available and fault-tolerant systems where correctness, uptime, observability and predictable behaviour are important operational requirements
Take end-to-end ownership across the software and infrastructure stack, including interaction with physical server hardware and management interfaces such as iLO
Build and maintain systems integrations covering areas such as authentication, MFA, identity functionality, access controls and other internally developed security capabilities
Own testing, deployment, monitoring and production troubleshooting, investigating anomalies thoroughly rather than treating operational issues as isolated incidents
Assess existing services and workflows critically, simplifying, replacing or rebuilding components where architectural or engineering improvements would materially strengthen the platform

What You’ll Bring…

Typically around 4-10 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally working on systems, infrastructure platforms, backend services or other technically demanding production environments
Strong programming fundamentals in at least one of C#, Java, Python, Go, Rust or C++, with evidence of building substantial production software rather than primarily scripting or configuration work
Hands-on Linux engineering experience alongside Ansible or comparable infrastructure automation, with confidence working below the application layer and understanding how systems are provisioned and operated
Strong understanding of concurrency, distributed or highly available systems, REST API design and the engineering trade-offs involved in building reliable production services
Experience owning software through testing, CI/CD, deployment, observability and live production support, with a disciplined approach to diagnosing complex or unexpected system behaviour
Evidence of broad technical curiosity and end-to-end ownership, including a willingness to investigate infrastructure, networking, operating-system or hardware-level issues beyond the immediate application boundary
(Preferred) Experience building proprietary internal platforms, infrastructure tooling or systems integrations within quantitative finance, trading, technology, research or another high-performance engineering environment
(Preferred) Exposure to IAM, MFA, PKI, cryptography, secure infrastructure or similar security concepts, although deep cyber-security or AppSec experience is not required

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title:
Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location:
Derry/Londonderry or Cambridge, United Kingdom (Hybrid)

Employment Type:
Full Time

The job

We’re looking for a motivated Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our 3DVis Cloud team at AVEVA.

You’ll contribute to the delivery of best-in-class 3D visualisation and XR (Extended Reality) cloud streaming technologies, supporting AVEVA’s industrial software portfolio. Your work will help ensure our cloud and on-premises solutions meet high standards of quality, robustness, and security.

This is a great opportunity for someone with some relevant experience who is excited by test automation, quality engineering, and cloud technologies, and who wants to grow their skills within a collaborative, scaled agile (SAFe) environment.

Key Responsibilities

We follow a scaled-agile software development methodology. You’ll be comfortable building collaborative relationships in a multi-disciplinary scrum team and taking ownership of test automation and quality improvements on moderately complex features. You will also be following AVEVA’s software development quality practices and policies

Your responsibilities will include:

Collaborate with developers, DevOps engineers and SDET engineers to define, implement, and execute functional and non-functional test coverage for our product, taking ownership of coverage for assigned features and work items.
Enhance our test automation by independently designing, writing, and maintaining automated tests using C# within existing frameworks and team patterns.
Maintain automated test execution by owning investigation of failures, improving test reliability (e.g., reducing flaky tests), and driving issues through to resolution within a continuous integration environment.
Use Azure DevOps Test Plans to plan and execute regression testing, and Azure DevOps Pipelines to configure and run deployments to test environments.
Improve our testing practices by identifying gaps in test coverage, proposing and implementing new test cases or automation improvements, and sharing best practices with the team.
Help maintain production quality by investigating production issues and driving preventative improvements, such as strengthening automated regression coverage and test automation.

Essential Requirements

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every skill.

Understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and how testing contributes to delivery.
Proven experience in functional testing in a professional software environment with exposure to non‑functional testing (e.g., reliability, performance, security) and the ability to take ownership of test coverage for assigned features.
Comfortable in writing and maintaining automated tests using C# within existing team practices producing robust maintainable tests.
Team-oriented and collaborative, with clear communication and strong organisational skills, able to work independently and collaboratively drive issues through to resolution with the team.
Methodical, proactive “can-do” attitude with a strong learning mindset and desire to grow technical depth

Desired Skills And Competencies

Exposure to CI/CD pipelines
Understanding of software development principles such as OOP, SOLID and DRY.
Familiarity with test automation frameworks
Familiarity with performance and load testing (e.g., k6 or similar tools).
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
Knowledge of Azure cloud services

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

By default, employees are expected to be in their local AVEVA office three days a week, but some positions are fully office-based. Roles supporting particular customers or markets are sometimes remote.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. new_jobs.title: Gametech Innovation Developer
new_jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

The Gametech Innovation team
is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.

As a Mid-Level Developer
within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What It Means On a Daily Basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What Success Will Look Like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who You Would Be Working With

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test You will be given a case study to complete.
Second interview A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine or Unity; and in C++ and C#
Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development work
Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self-explanatory code
Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

Who You Are

Naturally curious you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
Solution-driven you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
Private medical health insurance.
Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
Free language courses.
Work-from-home hybrid model.
Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

Life at
Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.
